ei.title: 6번: The Impact of Uncle Tom's Cabin
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: When Harriet Beecher Stowe published the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin in 1852, it had a significant effect on the United States. At that time, slavery was still legal in the southern part of the country. The book's anti-slavery message made people in the Northern states begin to realize just how bad slavery was. This was partly because Stowe wrote in a very personal, informal style that enabled readers to empathize with the slaves in her novel. Stowe's novel had a stronger effect than newspaper articles and political speeches. It inspired many ordinary Americans to believe that they could help make the world a better place. Nine years after Uncle Tom's Cabin was published, the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the end of slavery.

questions.passage: When Harriet Beecher Stowe published the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin in 1852, it had a (A)[minor / significant] effect on the United States. At that time, slavery was still legal in the southern part of the country. The book's anti-slavery message made people in the Northern states begin to realize just how bad slavery was. This was partly because Stowe wrote in a very personal, informal style that (B)[prevented / enabled] readers to empathize with the slaves in her novel. Stowe's novel had a (C)[stronger / weaker] effect than newspaper articles and political speeches. It inspired many ordinary Americans to believe that they could help make the world a better place. Nine years after Uncle Tom's Cabin was published, the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the end of slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) significant=중요한 / minor=사소한 (B) enabled=가능하게 했다 / prevented=막았다 (C) stronger=더 강한 / weaker=더 약한
det.analysis:
① significant—enabled—stronger: 소설이 중요한 영향을 미쳤고, 개인적 문체가 독자의 공감을 가능하게 했으며, 신문보다 더 강한 영향을 주었다 ←정답
② minor: 사소한 영향은 문맥과 반대
③ prevented/weaker: 막다/더 약한은 문맥과 반대
④ minor/prevented: 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 소설의 강력한 영향(significant, stronger)과 공감을 가능하게 한(enabled) 문체 흐름

It (C)[inspired / discouraged] many ordinary Americans to believe that they could help make the world a better place. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) legal=합법적인 / banned=금지된 (B) realize=깨닫다 / ignore=무시하다 (C) inspired=고무시켰다 / discouraged=낙담시켰다
det.analysis:
① banned: 당시 노예제는 여전히 합법(legal)이었음
② ignore/discouraged: 깨닫기 시작/고무와 반대
③ legal—realize—inspired: 합법 + 깨닫기 시작 + 고무 ←정답
④ banned/ignore: 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 노예제가 legal이었고 사람들이 realize하게 되었으며 사람들을 inspire한 흐름

questions.passage: When Harriet Beecher Stowe published the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin in 1852, it had a significant effect on the United States. At that time, slavery was still legal in the southern part of the country. The book's anti-slavery message made people in the Northern states begin to realize just how bad slavery was. This was partly because Stowe wrote in a very personal, informal style that enabled readers to empathize with the slaves in her novel. Stowe's novel had a stronger effect than newspaper articles and political speeches. It inspired many (A)[exceptional / ordinary] Americans to believe that they could help make the world a (B)[worse / better] place. Nine years after Uncle Tom's Cabin was published, the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the (C)[end / beginning] of slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) ordinary=평범한 / exceptional=예외적인 (B) better=더 나은 / worse=더 나쁜 (C) end=끝 / beginning=시작
det.analysis:
① exceptional: 평범한(ordinary) 미국인이 문맥
② worse/beginning: 더 나은/끝과 반대
③ exceptional/worse: 문맥과 반대
④ ordinary—better—end: 평범한 미국인 + 더 나은 세상 + 노예제의 끝 ←정답
det.tip: 평범한(ordinary) 사람들이 더 나은(better) 세상을 만들고 노예제의 끝(end)으로 이어진 흐름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① southern=남부의 ② Northern=북부의 ③ enable→prevent (부적절) ④ believe=믿다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① minor → significant(원문에서는 significant, 부적절) ② legal=합법적인 ③ personal=개인적인 ④ better=더 나은

③ personal: 개인적이고 격식 없는 문체 — 적절
④ better: 더 나은 세상 — 적절

④ began: 남북전쟁이 시작됨 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: lead(이끌다) → led(불규칙 과거형). 남북전쟁이 노예제의 종식으로 이어졌다는 과거 시제
det.analysis: lead를 불규칙 과거형 led로 변환. 'the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the end of slavery' — began과 같은 과거 시제. lead-led-led 불규칙 변화
det.tip: began과 병렬 과거 시제 + lead의 불규칙 과거형 → led

questions.passage: When Harriet Beecher Stowe published the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin in 1852, it had a significant effect on the United States. At that time, slavery was still legal in the southern part of the country. The book's anti-slavery message made people in the Northern states begin to realize just how bad slavery was. This was partly because Stowe wrote in a very personal, informal style that enabled readers to empathize with the slaves in her novel. Stowe's novel had a stronger effect than newspaper articles and political speeches. It inspired many ordinary Americans to believe that they could help make the world __________. Nine years after Uncle Tom's Cabin was published, the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the end of slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a better place=더 나은 곳 / a bigger house=더 큰 집 / a richer country=더 부유한 나라 / a stronger army=더 강한 군대
det.analysis:
① a better place: 평범한 미국인들이 세상을 더 나은 곳으로 만들 수 있다고 믿게 함 ←정답
② a bigger house: 세상을 더 큰 집으로? 부적절
③ a richer country: 세상을 더 부유한 나라로? 세상 전체와 안 맞음
④ a stronger army: 세상을 더 강한 군대로? 부적절
det.tip: help make the world ____ → 더 나은 곳(a better place)

questions.passage: When Harriet Beecher Stowe published the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin in 1852, it had a significant effect on the United States. At that time, slavery was still legal in the southern part of the country. The book's __________ made people in the Northern states begin to realize just how bad slavery was. This was partly because Stowe wrote in a very personal, informal style that enabled readers to empathize with the slaves in her novel. Stowe's novel had a stronger effect than newspaper articles and political speeches. It inspired many ordinary Americans to believe that they could help make the world a better place. Nine years after Uncle Tom's Cabin was published, the American Civil War began, which eventually led to the end of slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cheerful illustrations=유쾌한 삽화 / political advertisement=정치 광고 / anti-slavery message=반노예제 메시지 / boring statistics=지루한 통계
det.analysis:
① cheerful illustrations: 유쾌한 삽화가 노예제의 참상을 깨닫게 함? 부적절
② political advertisement: 정치 광고? 부적절
③ anti-slavery message: 책의 반노예제 메시지가 북부 사람들에게 노예제가 얼마나 나쁜지 깨닫게 함 ←정답
④ boring statistics: 지루한 통계? 감정적 공감과 안 맞음
det.tip: The book's ____ made people realize how bad slavery was → 반노예제 메시지(anti-slavery message)
